# effective-version
Version 2.0 is the current effective controlled subculture SOP. Superseded versions are not current operating authority.

# contamination-check
Before subculture, visually inspect the culture and vessel for contamination.

# approval
Subculture preparation may be described read-only, but execution requires a pending request and human approval.

# post-operation-records
Record strain ID, source vessel, target vessel, operator, time, generation, and observations after the operation.

# contamination-response
If contamination is suspected, isolate the culture and stop the normal subculture path pending review.
